page_title: NEW 4-1 CHE | Newcastle v Chelsea 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+3' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Amadou Diallo (Newcastle Utd) replaces Lewis Miley.
90+2' We are about to witness a substitution. Michael Ndiweni (Newcastle Utd) is replacing Anthony Gordon.
90+2' Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' A cross from Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
87' It will be a substitution. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) is ready to enter the pitch as Raheem Sterling walks off.
87' It is time for a substitution. Alex Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is on for Miguel Almiron.
86' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Paul Dummett (Newcastle Utd) replacing Jamaal Lascelles.
83' 4 - 1 Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
81' Substitution. Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) has come on for Alexander Isak.
81' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
77' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) duly receives a yellow card.
76' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
75' Jesus Perez makes a tactical change due to a red card. Levi Colwill comes on in place of Cole Palmer (Chelsea).
73' Reece James (Chelsea) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
71' Rough tackle by Reece James (Chelsea). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Armando Broja (Chelsea) coming on for Nicolas Jackson.
69' Substitution. Chimuanya Ugochukwu did his best and is replaced by Moises Caicedo (Chelsea).
69' Here is a change. Conor Gallagher is going off and Jesus Perez gives the last tactical orders to Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea).
61' 3 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Joelinton (Newcastle Utd), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 3:1.
60' 2 - 1 Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
59' This is a yellow card! Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
55' The referee is firm and issues Reece James (Chelsea) a deserved yellow card.
55' Poor challenge! Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is penalised for tripping and Simon Hooper blows his whistle.
53' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
52' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
52' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) latched on to the corner and struck a fine header from the edge of the box, but he missed the target.
52' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is about to take a corner kick.
51' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The ball is out of play and Newcastle manage to earn a corner.
47' Reece James (Chelsea) fails to convert the free kick from the edge of the box. His shot goes right into the stands. High, wide and not at all handsome.
46' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simon Hooper had an easy-decision to make.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Simon Hooper blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+2' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Robert Sanchez.
45+2' Reece James (Chelsea) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' A superb shot by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar.
41' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Chimuanya Ugochukwu (Chelsea) for his blatant foul.
40' The resulting corner from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
40' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Chelsea win a corner kick.
37' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.

32' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
32' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) takes the corner.

32' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Nick Pope anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
30' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robert Sanchez intercepts the ball.
29' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
26' What a miss! The corner finds Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
26' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

23' 1 - 1 Free kick from the edge of the penalty box. Ideal position for a player with brilliant shooting technique . And that is no one else than Raheem Sterling (Chelsea), who perfectly curls the ball into the back of the net. Beautiful football moment.
22' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Simon Hooper didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
17' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
16' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Simon Hooper has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

13' 1 - 0 Lewis Miley feeds the ball through to Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the middle of the goal! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
11' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
9' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post.
8' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
7' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) was too forceful with his tackle and Simon Hooper interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
3' Reece James (Chelsea) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
1' The first half has just begun.
Chelsea will kick-off.
Simon Hooper will referee today's match.
